title: Anthropic's approach to teaching and learning AI
summary: Anthropic launched Claude Academy, a public education platform teaching people to use AI safely and effectively using the '4D AI Fluency Framework' that focuses on mindsets and ethical disclosure over rigid feature training. The program offers personalized learning paths with Claude-powered recommendations accessible at academy.claude.com and integrated into Claude's profile menu.

title: How monday.com transformed its platform into an agent-first product where humans and agents collaborate
summary: monday.com rebuilt its work management platform around human-agent collaboration using Claude as the core AI engine, achieving 5 million agent interactions in the first months after its May 2026 launch. The platform supports four implementation methods including custom agents, bring-your-own-agent, pre-built agents, and Claude Coding integration, with 250,000+ companies already using specialized agents for IT triage, HR recruiting, and executive support. Case studies show tangible results, such as Cooke Seafood reducing manual reporting across 200+ projects.

title: The Claude Code Guide for Startups
summary: Anthropic released a guide distilling five operating principles that fast-growing startups use to ship faster with Claude Code, based on interviews with 15+ companies. The framework enables non-technical employees to build features while agents handle ~80% of mechanical dev tasks, with reported gains including ClickHouse shipping 30% more features, Omni seeing 2-3x engineering productivity, and Clay automating 100% of bug triage.

title: Claude on call: How Claude Tag serves as Anthropic's first responder for CI/CD failures
summary: Anthropic deployed Claude Tag as an automated first responder that detects, triages, and resolves CI/CD failures using an orchestrator/executor agent workflow. The system analyzes failures across Grafana, logs, GitHub, and Kubernetes, achieving median time-to-first-analysis of 14 minutes and reducing on-call engineer workload. Available for Claude Team/Enterprise plans with an open-source setup kit for other organizations.

title: The Claude Science product guide
summary: Claude Science is a new beta AI workbench designed specifically for life sciences research, using a local daemon architecture that keeps data on-premises while accessing cloud compute. It includes specialized life sciences skills and database connectors, addressing the critical gap where 91% of scientists want more AI in research but cite trust and reliability as barriers. The platform's five design principles ensure analyses withstand peer review and support workflows from discovery through publication.
